question: Which transcription factors have cell type enriched RNA expression, and in which single cell types? Give the number of such transcription factors per cell type as a bar chart of the fifteen cell types with the most. For the cell type with the most, list its transcription factors with their nCPM, the distribution of their RNA tissue specificity categories as a bar chart, and which of them have a validated prognostic association in any TCGA cohort. Provide the table.

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT \"Gene\",\"Protein class\",\"RNA single cell type specificity\",\"RNA single cell type distribution\",\"RNA single cell type specific nCPM\",\"RNA tissue specificity\" FROM proteinatlas WHERE lower(\"Protein class\") LIKE '%transcription factor%' AND lower(\"RNA single cell type specificity\") LIKE '%enriched%' LIMIT 20"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"WITH x AS (SELECT \"Gene\", trim(u) s FROM proteinatlas, unnest(string_split(\"RNA single cell type specific nCPM\", ';')) t(u) WHERE lower(\"Protein class\") LIKE '%transcription factor%' AND \"RNA single cell type specificity\"='Cell type enriched'), y AS (SELECT \"Gene\", trim(regexp_extract(s, '^([^:]+):', 1)) cell FROM x WHERE s LIKE '%:%') SELECT cell, count(DISTINCT \"Gene\") n FROM y GROUP BY cell ORDER BY n DESC, cell LIMIT 15"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"WITH x AS (SELECT \"Gene\", \"RNA tissue specificity\", trim(u) s FROM proteinatlas, unnest(string_split(\"RNA single cell type specific nCPM\", ';')) t(u) WHERE lower(\"Protein class\") LIKE '%transcription factor%' AND \"RNA single cell type specificity\"='Cell type enriched'), y AS (SELECT \"Gene\", \"RNA tissue specificity\", TRY_CAST(regexp_extract(s, ':\\s*([0-9.]+)$',1) AS DOUBLE) nCPM FROM x WHERE trim(regexp_extract(s,'^([^:]+):',1))='Neutrophils') SELECT y.\"Gene\", y.nCPM, y.\"RNA tissue specificity\", CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cancer_prognostic_data c WHERE c.\"Gene\"=y.\"Gene\" AND (TRY_CAST(c.\"validated prognostic - favorable\" AS DOUBLE)>0 OR TRY_CAST(c.\"validated prognostic - unfavorable\" AS DOUBLE)>0)) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END validated_TCGA FROM y ORDER BY y.nCPM DESC, y.\"Gene\""}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT \"Gene\",\"Gene name\",\"Cancer\",\"validated prognostic - favorable\",\"validated prognostic - unfavorable\" FROM cancer_prognostic_data WHERE \"Gene\" IN ('ELF2','NFKBIZ','BCL6','STAT5B','ZNF438','ZNF429','ZNF281','ZNF746') AND (\"validated prognostic - favorable\" IS NOT NULL OR \"validated prognostic - unfavorable\" IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 50"}
